label: Ordinary nominee-allocation attribution vocabulary: a workspace actor's attested statement that a stated amount of interest reported on an identified Form 1099-INT belongs to a named other (non-spouse) recipient. Records the ordinary proposition only, without its speaker; a later adopted rule, not this fact type, decides any nominee-interest tax consequence.

fact_types.title: The amount of interest reported on this identified Form 1099-INT that is allocated to this named other person. The enclosing act supplies who stated it and when; this fact carries no nominee-interest characterization, Schedule B classification, or reporting conclusion. Identity shares the box-1 report's own payer, statement, and tax-year components (packages/tax/report_statement_identity.py), plus an application-minted recipient entity, never derived from typed text.
